毒阵预警，静候猎物（毒阵预警，静候猎物（。五个人。清一色的等级25级。全是苍穹榜上有名有姓的顶尖玩家。走在最前方的小队队长，手里举着一把散发着耀眼金光的极品法器长剑。在他的头顶上方，悬浮着一把淡金色的半透明油纸伞。油纸伞缓慢旋转，垂下一道圆柱形的金色光瀑，将五人牢牢护在中央。外面的剧毒瘴气触碰到光瀑，发出“嗤嗤”的声响，却无法渗透分毫。高阶群体防御法宝。氪金玩家的标配。“哈哈哈哈！发财了！”队长看清了眼前的景象。收起长剑，发出一阵狂放的大笑。百亩大小的阶梯状药田，在穹顶月光石的照耀下展露无遗。虽然满地枯萎，但空气中弥漫的陈年药土味，让这些顶尖高玩的眼睛瞬间发红。“我的天！绝对是上古废弃药园！这规模也太离谱了！”左侧的一名剑客玩家激动得声音打颤。他直接拿出三个巨大的储物袋，“别管草是死是活。这里的随便一撮土带出去，都能高价卖给公会的炼丹大宗师！”“都小心点！系统设定，这种高收益资源点，肯定有守护妖兽或者陷阱阵法。”最后一名手持八卦罗盘的女玩家提醒了一句。但她那轻松的语气中，并没有多少忌惮。他们可是神宗的天骄开荒小队。一身砸了重金的极品神装，满背包的瞬间恢复药剂。在目前的游戏阶段，除非遇到三十级以上的隐藏领主boss。否则，他们就是横推一切的存在。“怕个鸟！神挡杀神，佛挡杀佛。走！进去刮地三尺！”队长大手一挥。五个人收起兵刃。神态轻松，有说有笑。他们将这里当成了自家后花园的提款机，大步迈向药田的方向。一步。两步。三步。他们的靴底，准确无误地踏入了通道最中央那片灰白色的泥土。结结实实地踩进了苏寒精心布置的立体杀阵正中心。黑暗中。碳化枯树的阴影下。那双没有任何温度的漆黑眼眸，缓缓睁开。猎物，入笼。

Chapter 100 Poison Array Warning Waiting for Prey (Page 1)
Poison array early warning, waiting for prey (poison array early warning, waiting for prey). Five people. All level 25. They are all top players with names on the sky list. The leader of the team walking in the front holds a top-quality magic weapon that exudes dazzling golden light. On top of his head is the long sword. Above, a pale golden translucent oil-paper umbrella rotates slowly, hanging down a cylindrical golden light waterfall, firmly protecting the five people in the center. The poisonous miasma outside touches the light waterfall, making a "chichi" sound, but it cannot penetrate at all. Treasure. The standard equipment for krypton gold players. "Hahahaha! Rich!" The captain put away his sword and let out a wild laugh. The hundred-acre-sized terraced medicinal field was exposed under the light of the moonstone, but the air was full of decay. The earthy smell of old medicine made the eyes of these top players turn red instantly. "Oh my God! It's definitely an ancient abandoned medicine garden! The scale is too outrageous!" A swordsman player on the left said with excitement in his voice. He took out three huge storage bags, "Don't worry about whether the grass is dead or alive. The random things here. Even a handful of soil can be sold to the guild's alchemy master at a high price! "Be careful! The system is set up. There must be guardian monsters or trap formations for this kind of high-yield resource point," the last female player holding the Bagua Compass warned. But her tone was relaxed. , not much to worry about. They are the talented pioneer team of Shenzong. They are equipped with the best divine equipment and a backpack full of instant recovery potions. At the current stage of the game, unless they encounter a hidden lord boss of level 30 or above, they will dominate everything. "Afraid of a bird! Go in and scrape the ground." The five men put away their weapons, talking and laughing. They took one step and two steps towards the medicine field. The soles of their boots accurately stepped into the gray-white soil in the center of the passage. They stepped firmly into the center of Su Han's carefully arranged three-dimensional killing array. Under the shadow of the carbonized dead trees, the prey slowly opened.
